message.content: {"draft":"Single-block row softmax. Load FP32, subtract max, exp, sum, divide. Mask padded lanes with -inf. One program per row.","plan":"Keep one CTA per row. Use next_pow2 block. Load, max, exp, sum, div, store. No loops. Fresh contiguous output.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _softmax_kernel(","    input_ptr,","    output_ptr,","    input_row_stride,","    output_row_stride,","    n_cols,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","    IS_BF16: tl.constexpr,","):","    row_idx = tl.program_id(0)","    col_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = col_offsets < n_cols","    row_ptr = input_ptr + row_idx * input_row_stride","    row = tl.load(row_ptr + col_offsets, mask=mask, other=-float('inf')).to(tl.float32)","    row_max = tl.max(row, axis=0)","    numerator = tl.exp(row - row_max)","    denominator = tl.sum(numerator, axis=0)","    result = numerator / denominator","    if IS_BF16:","        result = result.to(tl.bfloat16)","    out_ptr = output_ptr + row_idx * output_row_stride","    tl.store(out_ptr + col_offsets, result, mask=mask)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()","    n_rows, n_cols = x.shape","    out = torch.empty_like(x)","    BLOCK_SIZE = triton.next_power_of_2(n_cols)","    grid = (n_rows,)","    is_bf16 = x.dtype == torch.bfloat16","    _softmax_kernel[grid](","        x,","        out,","        x.stride(0),","        out.stride(0),","        n_cols,","        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,","        IS_BF16=is_bf16,","    )","    return out"]}
